Mirikizumab is a new treatment preparation for inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). In 2024, it was assigned a new treatment code in the [[landspatientregisteret|Landspatientregisteret]] (LPR), a significant administrative update that enables its inclusion in the DANIBD report's Indicator 5 data [^src1]. This specific quality indicator tracks fecal calprotectin measurements in patients receiving biologic and immunomodulator therapies [^src1].

The introduction of this code was part of a broader methodological update documented in the 2024 DANIBD report, which implemented new registry codes for several modern biologics and JAK inhibitors. Alongside mirikizumab, new treatment codes were simultaneously established for [[upadacitinib]], [[filgotinib]], [[risankizumab]], and [[ozanimod]] [^src1]. These additions reflect the registry's ongoing efforts to accurately capture, track, and monitor the quality of care for patients receiving these advanced IBD therapies [^src1].
